newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivorian cocoa bean exports dwindle in August.
newsitem.headline: Ivorian cocoa bean exports dwindle in August.

text.p: Ivory Coast's cocoa bean exports fell to 4,440 tonnes in August against a strong 48,566 tonnes in July, official data show.
Traders had expected a drop after deliveries against the squeezed September contract in London had boosted July figures.
Exports in August last year amounted to 11,939 tonnes and in 1993/94 they were 16,108 tonnes.
Cumulative exports for the first 11 months of 1995/96 (October-September) were 1,058,467 tonnes against 749,234 tonnes in the same period of 1994/95.
The figures showed that Abidjan handled 3,560 tonnes of beans last month and San Pedro, Ivory Coast's second port, shipped 880 tonnes.
Ivory Coast's 1995/96 crop is forecast at a record 1.2 million tonnes, about a third more than the previous best crop in 1994/95.
